meaning: The publisher reports that no operations took place in that maturity-and-portfolio cell in that month, so no rate exists to report. It is not a zero rate and not an unavailable datum: a zero would assert that money changed hands at 0%, and treating it as an ordinary blank hides that the publisher gave a definite answer.
evidence: The token appears 38,584 times in this source, concentrated in the interest-rate tables: 12,205 cells on sheet 3.1, 12,200 on 3.2, 4,105 on 6, 2,440 on 2.2, 2,438 on 2.1, 2,269 on 5, 1,180 on 1.2, 1,179 on 1.1 and 97 on 8. 18,416 of them sit at a period the series' own declared monthly frequency expects, which is why they surfaced as missing observations. Read as 'sin movimiento'.

meaning: The same publisher convention as the financial-indicator tables: the cell's period had no operations, so there is no figure to report.
